title: More ways to use text generation
summary:
Two text options and longer OpenAI requests led the day, alongside a new community bot and some careful work under the text API’s hood.

Added `openai-reasoning`, backed by o1-mini, and `hypnosis-tracy`, a self-help hypnosis persona. The OpenAI text request limit doubled from 256,000 to 512,000 message characters.

Gacha joined the Social Bots listings with chat, web search, and character-aware image generation. Project repository links now point directly to their repos, and authors can link to profiles beyond Discord.

OpenAI-style responses preserve existing IDs and creation timestamps. Several text generators moved to a shared client, while SearchGPT gained support for an explicitly selected model instead of always forcing its default. The changes also adjusted Hugging Face request limits and expanded integration tests.

highlights.title: Reasoning with o1-mini
highlights.text: Use `openai-reasoning` for text requests routed to o1-mini. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-reasoning).

highlights.title: Meet hypnosis-tracy
highlights.text: Try `hypnosis-tracy`, a self-help hypnosis persona backed by the text generator. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=hypnosis-tracy).

highlights.title: Longer text requests
highlights.text: The OpenAI text request limit doubled to 512,000 message characters, leaving more room for long conversations and inputs. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
